deferredToContractItem: the exact schema of the uncertainty and sample-size report

binding.od5Preservation: OD-5 is unchanged: SUFFICIENT_SUPPORT is never emitted with structuralGatesPass = false; that condition introduces no additional abstainReason value and fails closed. Sufficiency never truncates, re-ranks or silently narrows the analogue set; under INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT the frozen set is still emitted with exclusion reasons.

notes: exclusionCountsByReason is an array of twelve { reasonId, count } entries in GATE25_ELIGIBILITY_EXCLUSION_REASON_V1 precedence order, because a keyed object would be re-sorted by CanonicalJSON/1.

structuralGatesPass is true only when the query is comparable: identity resolved at T, a GATE24 RegimeRecord bound, volatilityState classifying, both distance features RESOLVED and finite, and every query input availableAt <= K(T).
eligibleCount >= 2 with structuralGatesPass false is an engine fail-closed condition and emits no report; supportReportId is sha256Canonical of the closed report.
